summary: Aris Mining Corp filed a Form 6-K with Exhibit 99.1 reporting its Q1 2026 financial results. The press release discloses record revenue of $364M, adjusted EBITDA of $212M, and gold production of 74.3 koz. There is no mention of any structural corporate event such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC transaction, or forced management change. The CEO's comments describe routine operational progress and growth projects. This is a standard earnings release for a foreign private issuer.
